  • Constructor Details

    • ClientRMI

      public ClientRMI(UserView userView) throws RemoteException
      Represents a client for the RMI (Remote Method Invocation) system. It exports the object as an RMI remote object and initializes various executors.
      Parameters:
      userView - The `UserView` object associated with this client.
      Throws:
      RemoteException - If there's an issue with remote communication.

  • Method Details

    • connect

      public void connect(String addr)
      Connects to the RMI server at the specified address. This method sets the system property for the RMI server hostname, looks up the remote server, and initializes communication with it.
      Specified by:
      connect in class Client
      Parameters:
      addr - The address of the RMI server.
      Throws:
      RuntimeException - If there's an issue during connection.

    • placeCard

      public void placeCard(int idx, int x, int y, boolean face)
      Places a card on the game board. This method submits the task to the client executor, which communicates with the server by invoking the `placeCardMsg` method on the communication object.
      Specified by:
      placeCard in class Client
      Parameters:
      idx - The index of the card.
      x - The x-coordinate on the game board.
      y - The y-coordinate on the game board.
      face - Whether the card is face-up or face-down.

    • drawCard

      public void drawCard(int idx)
      Draws a card from the game deck. This method submits the task to the client executor, which communicates with the server by invoking the `drawCardMsg` method on the communication object.
      Specified by:
      drawCard in class Client
      Parameters:
      idx - The index of the card to be drawn.
